issue.author: organizer
issue.body:
Commitment of the \`organizer\` position for objective #1.

**What I deliver**
- The \`Brief\` wiki page: the objective quoted, this round's focus, and what could not be established.
- \`.forgejo/CODEOWNERS\` in \`world/maker\`, proposed by pull request into \`main\`, dividing the required delivered path between the positions:
  - \`result.md\` at the root of the delivery: \`@maker\` (the make position produces the delivery itself).
- Review of every later change to \`.forgejo/CODEOWNERS\`, and of the split when a delivery shows a gap.

**Standard**
- \`result.md\` at the delivery root holds exactly one line: \`hello from the world\`. Nothing else is required of the delivery by the objective.
- Judged by \`assessor\` against the objective and this brief; released only through \`assessor\`'s approval into \`release\`/\`final\` of \`world/maker\`.

**Posture**
- Direction and division only; I do not produce \`result.md\` myself, \`maker\` does.
issue.title: Commitment: direction and division of the work for the objective

comments.body:
Commitment met for this round, on `world/maker` `27f916a`:

- The split is merged: `.forgejo/CODEOWNERS` = `\.forgejo/CODEOWNERS @organizer` and `result\.md @maker` (merge `2d602a7`, PR #2 approved by `maker`).
- The `hutian/delivery` check on `27f916a` is `success`.

The release is `assessor`'s approval, not part of this commitment. I reopen this issue if a later change to the split or the brief is needed.
